question.t: 假設你在全域設定 (`~/.gitconfig`) 中設定了 `user.email` 為 `personal@example.com`，但在專案目錄下的 `.git/config` 中設定了 `user.email` 為 `work@company.com`。當你在該專案目錄執行 commit 時，Git 會使用哪個 Email？
question.en: Suppose you configured `user.email` as `personal@example.com` in your global config (`~/.gitconfig`), but set `user.email` as `work@company.com` in the local project config (`.git/config`). Which email will Git use when you commit in that project directory?

options.t: (A) 使用 `personal@example.com`，因為全域設定優先級最高。
options.en: (A) Uses `personal@example.com` because global config has the highest priority.

options.t: (B) 使用 `work@company.com`，因為 Local 設定會覆蓋 Global 設定。
options.en: (B) Uses `work@company.com` because Local config overrides Global config.

options.t: (C) Git 會報錯，要求你刪除其中一個設定以消除衝突。
options.en: (C) Git will throw an error asking you to remove one of the configs to resolve the conflict.

options.t: (D) 隨機選擇，取決於環境變數載入的順序。
options.en: (D) Selected randomly, depending on the order in which environment variables are loaded.

why.t: Git 的配置遵循「層級化覆蓋」原則：Local (`.git/config`) > Global (`~/.gitconfig`) > System。因此專案層級的設定 (Local) 優先級最高，會覆蓋全域設定。
why.en: Git configuration follows the 'Cascading Overrides' principle: Local (`.git/config`) > Global (`~/.gitconfig`) > System. Therefore, the project-level config (Local) has the highest priority and overrides the global settings.

question.t: 身為資深工程師，你經常在同一台電腦上切換公司專案 (位於 `~/work/`) 與個人專案 (位於 `~/personal/`)。為了避免用錯 Email 提交，根據 Handbook，下列哪種配置方式最符合「自動化」與「最佳實務」？
question.en: As a senior engineer, you frequently switch between company projects (in `~/work/`) and personal projects (in `~/personal/`) on the same machine. To avoid committing with the wrong email, which configuration approach best aligns with 'automation' and 'best practices' according to the Handbook?

options.t: (A) 在每個新專案 `git init` 後，手動執行 `git config user.email ...`。
options.en: (A) Manually run `git config user.email ...` after every `git init` in a new project.

options.t: (B) 使用 `[includeIf "gitdir:~/work/"]` 在全域設定中動態引入公司專用的設定檔。
options.en: (B) Use `[includeIf "gitdir:~/work/"]` in the global config to dynamically include a company-specific config file.

options.t: (C) 建立兩個不同的 OS 使用者帳號，分別用於工作與個人用途。
options.en: (C) Create two different OS user accounts, one for work and one for personal use.

options.t: (D) 撰寫一個 shell script，每次開啟終端機時詢問今天要使用哪個身份。
options.en: (D) Write a shell script that asks which identity to use every time you open a terminal.

why.t: 使用 `includeIf` 是管理多重身份的最佳實務。它能根據專案所在目錄自動切換配置 (Context-Aware Configuration)，無需人工介入，避免了手動設定容易遺忘的風險。
why.en: Using `includeIf` is the best practice for managing multiple identities. It automatically switches configurations based on the project directory (Context-Aware Configuration) without manual intervention, avoiding the risk of forgetting to set it manually.

question.t: 在 Handbook 的 Alias 推薦中，建議將 `pf` 設定為 `push --force-with-lease` 而非單純的 `--force`。請問 `--force-with-lease` 提供了什麼額外的安全保障？
question.en: In the Handbook's Alias recommendations, it is suggested to map `pf` to `push --force-with-lease` instead of a simple `--force`. What additional safety guarantee does `--force-with-lease` provide?

options.t: (A) 它會先備份遠端分支到本地的一個暫存分支，然後再強制推送。
options.en: (A) It backs up the remote branch to a local temporary branch before force pushing.

options.t: (B) 它會檢查遠端分支是否有其他人推送了新變更（與本地追蹤的狀態不符），若有則拒絕推送。
options.en: (B) It checks if the remote branch has new changes pushed by others (mismatch with local tracking status) and rejects the push if so.

options.t: (C) 它只允許在 Feature Branch 上強制推送，禁止在 master/main 上操作。
options.en: (C) It only allows force pushing on Feature Branches and forbids it on master/main.

options.t: (D) 它會在推送前強制執行單元測試，若測試失敗則取消推送。
options.en: (D) It forces unit tests to run before pushing and cancels the push if tests fail.

why.t: `--force-with-lease` 就像加了保險鎖的強制推送。它確保你「以為的遠端狀態」與「實際的遠端狀態」一致。如果在你 pull 之後有同事 push 了新 code，你的本地追蹤分支就會過期，此時 lease 機制會阻止你覆蓋同事的程式碼。
why.en: `--force-with-lease` is like a force push with a safety lock. It ensures that 'what you think the remote state is' matches the 'actual remote state'. If a colleague pushed new code after you pulled, your local tracking branch is outdated, and the lease mechanism will prevent you from overwriting their code.

question.t: 你的團隊剛對整個專案進行了大規模的 Prettier/ESLint 格式化。現在使用 `git blame` 時，大部分行都顯示為該次格式化的 commit，導致無法追蹤真正的修改歷史。根據 Handbook，最有效的解決方案是什麼？
question.en: Your team just ran a massive Prettier/ESLint formatting across the entire project. Now, when using `git blame`, most lines point to that formatting commit, making it impossible to trace the actual history. According to the Handbook, what is the most effective solution?

options.t: (A) 使用 `git rebase -i` 將格式化的 commit 從歷史中刪除。
options.en: (A) Use `git rebase -i` to remove the formatting commit from history.

options.t: (B) 建立 `.git-blame-ignore-revs` 檔案紀錄該 commit hash，並設定 `blame.ignoreRevsFile`。
options.en: (B) Create a `.git-blame-ignore-revs` file to record the commit hash and configure `blame.ignoreRevsFile`.

options.t: (C) 以後禁止全域格式化，只允許修改自己負責的檔案。
options.en: (C) Forbid global formatting in the future; only allow modifying files you are responsible for.

options.t: (D) 使用 `git log -p` 手動過濾掉格式化變更。
options.en: (D) Use `git log -p` to manually filter out formatting changes.

why.t: Git 提供了忽略特定 commit 的機制。透過設定 `blame.ignoreRevsFile`，你可以告訴 Git 在執行 blame 計算時「跳過」那些純粹是格式修正的 commit，從而顯示該行程式碼在格式化之前的真正作者與修改時間。
why.en: Git provides a mechanism to ignore specific commits. By configuring `blame.ignoreRevsFile`, you tell Git to 'skip' those purely formatting commits during blame calculation, thereby revealing the true author and modification time before the formatting.

keywords: autocrlf, line endings, windows, mac, cross-platform

question.t: 在一個混合使用 Windows 與 macOS/Linux 的團隊中，為了避免「僅換行符號變更 (Line Endings only)」汙染 commit 紀錄，下列關於 `core.autocrlf` 的設定建議何者正確？
question.en: In a team using a mix of Windows and macOS/Linux, to prevent 'Line Endings only' changes from polluting the commit history, which of the following recommendations for `core.autocrlf` is correct?

options.t: (A) Windows 設為 `true`，macOS/Linux 設為 `input`。
options.en: (A) Set to `true` on Windows, and `input` on macOS/Linux.

options.t: (B) Windows 設為 `input`，macOS/Linux 設為 `true`。
options.en: (B) Set to `input` on Windows, and `true` on macOS/Linux.

options.t: (C) 所有平台都設為 `false`，保持原樣。
options.en: (C) Set to `false` on all platforms to keep as-is.

options.t: (D) 所有平台都設為 `true`，強制轉換為 CRLF。
options.en: (D) Set to `true` on all platforms to force conversion to CRLF.

why.t: 最佳實務是「Checkout Windows style (CRLF), Commit Unix style (LF)」。Windows 使用者應設為 `true` (下載轉 CRLF，上傳轉 LF)；macOS/Linux 使用者應設為 `input` (下載不轉，上傳轉 LF 以防萬一)。這樣 Repo 內永遠保持 LF。
why.en: The best practice is 'Checkout Windows style (CRLF), Commit Unix style (LF)'. Windows users should set it to `true` (convert to CRLF on checkout, LF on commit); macOS/Linux users should set it to `input` (no conversion on checkout, convert to LF on commit just in case). This keeps the repo consistently LF.

codeSnippet: git config --global alias.trim "!git branch --merged | grep -v '*' | xargs -n 1 git branch -d"

question.t: Handbook 提到一個清理分支的 Alias (如上程式碼)。請問字串開頭的驚嘆號 `!` 在 Git Alias 中代表什麼意義？
question.en: The Handbook mentions a branch cleanup alias (as shown in the code snippet). What does the exclamation mark `!` at the beginning of the string signify in a Git Alias?

options.t: (A) 表示這是一個 Shell 指令，而非 Git 子指令。
options.en: (A) Indicates that this is a Shell command, not a Git subcommand.

options.t: (B) 表示這是一個「強制執行」的指令，忽略錯誤。
options.en: (B) Indicates that this is a 'force execution' command, ignoring errors.

options.t: (C) 表示這是一個 Root 權限指令，需要 sudo。
options.en: (C) Indicates that this is a Root permission command requiring sudo.

options.t: (D) 這只是裝飾符號，沒有實際功能。
options.en: (D) It is just a decorative symbol with no actual function.

why.t: 在 Git Alias 中，如果別名以 `!` 開頭，Git 會將其視為外部 Shell 指令執行，而不是 Git 內部的子指令 (如 `git checkout`)。這允許你在 Alias 中使用管道 (`|`)、`grep`、`xargs` 等強大的 Shell 功能。
why.en: In Git Alias, if the alias starts with `!`, Git treats it as an external Shell command rather than an internal Git subcommand (like `git checkout`). This allows you to use powerful Shell features like pipes (`|`), `grep`, and `xargs` within your alias.

question.t: 你依照手冊建議將 VS Code 設為 Git 的預設編輯器（如上指令）。然而當你執行 `git commit` 時，VS Code 雖然開啟了，但終端機卻立即顯示「Aborting commit due to empty commit message」並結束程序，導致你無法輸入訊息。請問原因為何？
question.en: You followed the handbook to set VS Code as your default Git editor (command above). However, when you run `git commit`, VS Code opens, but the terminal immediately shows 'Aborting commit due to empty commit message' and exits, preventing you from entering a message. What is the cause?

options.t: (A) VS Code 無法作為 Git 編輯器，必須使用 Vim 或 Nano。
options.en: (A) VS Code cannot be used as a Git editor; you must use Vim or Nano.

options.t: (B) 缺少 `--wait` 參數，導致 Shell 指令在開啟 VS Code 後未等待視窗關閉即繼續執行。
options.en: (B) Missing the `--wait` flag, causing the Shell command to proceed immediately without waiting for the VS Code window to close.

options.t: (C) Git 設定檔路徑錯誤，導致無法正確讀取編輯器設定。
options.en: (C) The Git config file path is incorrect, causing the editor settings to not be read properly.

options.t: (D) VS Code 必須以系統管理員身分執行才能寫入 commit 訊息。
options.en: (D) VS Code must be run as administrator to write the commit message.

why.t: GUI 編輯器（如 VS Code）預設會立即將控制權交還給終端機。必須加入 `--wait` 參數（例如 `code --wait`），告訴 Shell 需等待該編輯器視窗關閉後，才視為編輯完成並繼續執行 Commit 流程。
why.en: GUI editors (like VS Code) default to returning control to the terminal immediately. You must add the `--wait` flag (e.g., `code --wait`) to tell the Shell to wait for the editor window to close before considering the edit complete and proceeding with the commit process.

question.t: 手冊中提到可以設定 `help.autocorrect` 來自動修正打錯的指令。請問設定值為 `1` 代表什麼意思？
question.en: The handbook mentions setting `help.autocorrect` to automatically fix typoed commands. What does the value `1` represent?

options.t: (A) 代表「開啟」此功能（布林值 True）。
options.en: (A) It means 'Enable' this feature (Boolean True).

options.t: (B) 代表 Git 會等待 1 秒鐘後執行修正後的指令。
options.en: (B) It means Git will wait 1 second before executing the corrected command.

options.t: (C) 代表 Git 會等待 0.1 秒鐘後執行修正後的指令。
options.en: (C) It means Git will wait 0.1 seconds before executing the corrected command.

options.t: (D) 代表 Git 允許修正 1 個字元以內的拼寫錯誤。
options.en: (D) It means Git allows correcting spelling errors within 1 character.

why.t: 在 Git 設定中，`help.autocorrect` 的數值單位是「十分之一秒 (deciseconds)」。因此設為 `1` 代表等待 0.1 秒；若設為 `20` 則代表等待 2 秒。
why.en: In Git configuration, the unit for `help.autocorrect` is 'deciseconds'. Therefore, setting it to `1` means waiting 0.1 seconds; setting it to `20` would mean waiting 2 seconds.

question.t: 手冊將 `pull.rebase true` 列為基礎配置的黃金標準之一。請問啟用此設定的主要好處是什麼？
question.en: The handbook lists `pull.rebase true` as one of the golden standards for basic configuration. What is the primary benefit of enabling this setting?

options.t: (A) 它能加快 `git pull` 的下載速度。
options.en: (A) It speeds up the download speed of `git pull`.

options.t: (B) 它能避免在同步遠端變更時產生無意義的 Merge Commit，保持歷史線乾淨。
options.en: (B) It prevents meaningless Merge Commits when syncing remote changes, keeping the history clean.

options.t: (C) 它會自動解決所有的程式碼衝突。
options.en: (C) It automatically resolves all code conflicts.

options.t: (D) 它強制將本地變更直接覆蓋遠端變更（Force Push）。
options.en: (D) It forces local changes to overwrite remote changes directly (Force Push).

why.t: 預設的 `git pull` 行為是 `fetch` + `merge`，這容易在多人協作時產生大量「Merge branch 'main' of...」的交錯節點。開啟 `rebase` 模式後，Git 會將你的本地 commit 「重播」在遠端最新進度之後，維持線性的歷史紀錄。
why.en: The default `git pull` behavior is `fetch` + `merge`, which often creates many 'Merge branch main of...' crossover nodes in collaboration. Enabling `rebase` mode makes Git 'replay' your local commits on top of the remote's latest progress, maintaining a linear history.

question.t: 你在網路上看到教學建議使用上述指令來設定遠端倉庫，以避免每次推送都要輸入密碼。根據 Handbook 的「Anti-patterns」章節，為什麼這是一個危險的做法？
question.en: You saw a tutorial online suggesting the command above to set up a remote repository to avoid typing passwords every time. According to the 'Anti-patterns' section of the Handbook, why is this a dangerous practice?

options.t: (A) 這樣會導致 Git 連線速度變慢。
options.en: (A) This will cause Git connection speeds to slow down.

options.t: (B) GitHub 已經不再支援 HTTPS 協定。
options.en: (B) GitHub no longer supports the HTTPS protocol.

options.t: (C) 密碼會以明文儲存在 `.git/config` 中，執行 `git remote -v` 或分享 dotfiles 時會洩漏憑證。
options.en: (C) The password is stored in plaintext in `.git/config`, exposing credentials when running `git remote -v` or sharing dotfiles.

options.t: (D) 這種寫法會導致 Git 無法正確追蹤分支。
options.en: (D) This syntax will cause Git to fail to track branches correctly.

why.t: 將密碼直接寫在 URL 中是極度不安全的，因為它會被記錄在 config 檔與歷史指令中。正確做法是使用 Git Credential Helper (`credential.helper`) 或 SSH Key 來管理驗證。
why.en: Embedding passwords directly in the URL is extremely insecure as it gets recorded in config files and command history. The correct approach is to use a Git Credential Helper (`credential.helper`) or SSH Keys for authentication management.

codeSnippet: git config --global alias.deploy-prod "!git test && git build && git tag ... (10 more steps)"

question.t: 你的同事提議建立一個名為 `deploy-prod` 的 Git Alias（如上），將測試、建置、發布等 10 個步驟封裝起來。Handbook 對此類「過度 Alias (Over-Aliasing)」的建議為何？
question.en: Your colleague proposes creating a Git Alias named `deploy-prod` (as above) to encapsulate 10 steps including testing, building, and publishing. What is the Handbook's advice regarding such 'Over-Aliasing'?

options.t: (A) 這是一個好主意，可以大幅提升個人生產力。
options.en: (A) This is a great idea and can significantly boost personal productivity.

options.t: (B) 應避免此做法。複雜流程應寫成 Script 納入版控，而非隱藏在個人的 Git Config 中，以免難以維護與分享。
options.en: (B) Avoid this practice. Complex workflows should be written as scripts and version-controlled, rather than hidden in personal Git Config, to ensure maintainability and shareability.

options.t: (C) Git Alias 不支援串接多個指令，所以此 Alias 無法執行。
options.en: (C) Git Alias does not support chaining multiple commands, so this Alias will not execute.

options.t: (D) 應該將此 Alias 設定為 `--system` 層級讓全公司使用。
options.en: (D) This Alias should be set at the `--system` level for the entire company to use.

why.t: Alias 的目的是「認知壓縮」而非「隱藏邏輯」。當流程過於複雜，若只存在於個人的 config 中，新人無法學習，且換電腦後容易遺失。正確做法是撰寫成 `./scripts/deploy.sh` 並 commit 進專案。
why.en: The purpose of an Alias is 'cognitive compression', not 'hiding logic'. When a workflow is too complex and exists only in personal config, new members cannot learn from it, and it's easily lost when switching machines. The correct practice is to write it as `./scripts/deploy.sh` and commit it to the project.

question.t: 為了改善 Git Diff 的可讀性，你安裝了 `delta` 工具。若希望在終端機中看到類似 GitHub PR 的「左右對照 (Side-by-Side)」效果，應在 Git Config 加入哪項設定？
question.en: To improve Git Diff readability, you installed the `delta` tool. If you want to see a 'Side-by-Side' comparison in the terminal similar to GitHub PRs, which setting should you add to Git Config?

options.t: (A) `[diff] tool = vscode`
options.en: (A) `[diff] tool = vscode`

options.t: (B) `[core] pager = delta --split`
options.en: (B) `[core] pager = delta --split`

options.t: (C) `[delta] side-by-side = true`
options.en: (C) `[delta] side-by-side = true`

options.t: (D) `[merge] conflictStyle = diff3`
options.en: (D) `[merge] conflictStyle = diff3`

why.t: 根據 Handbook 的實戰案例，`delta` 工具提供了豐富的配置選項，其中 `side-by-side = true` 可以開啟左右並排的 Diff 顯示模式。
why.en: According to the real-world examples in the Handbook, the `delta` tool offers rich configuration options, where `side-by-side = true` enables the side-by-side diff display mode.
